turns.input: For a speech timing test, repeat exactly: The workspace is clear. Your files are unchanged. I'm ready for the next task.
Para una prueba de voz, repite exactamente: La primera frase termina aquí. La siguiente continúa con naturalidad. Sin pausas interminables.

continuous_speech.playback: muted duration simulation with real model and PCM generation

incremental_research.owner: Native Hermes/Codex; typed presentation-only research_sources/research_result actions
incremental_research.counts: Distinct selected URLs and actual renderer-acknowledged page panels; no page-load verification claim

self_development.reasoning_owner: Native CodexAppServerSession; native Codex threads retain coding history
self_development.controller_role: Scoped release proposals, approval grants, validation, installation journal and diagnostics; no custom reasoning/task/memory runtime
self_development.scope: Allowlisted existing desktop UI, voice adapters and conversation contract in the isolated pilot
self_development.commands: Native coding shell/patch tools inside the candidate. Named permission profile denies network and credential reads; outer bubblewrap hides host projects, IDE sessions and approval broker.
self_development.approval: Exact candidate/baseline hashes plus full diff; only trusted desktop user route can approve. Voice yes and model tool calls cannot grant installation.
self_development.updates: Apply after owned app/backend close; preserve state/credentials; check voice and renderer readiness for up to 210 seconds; restore previous source on startup failure or interrupted install. User-requested rollback is available for installed patches.
self_development.incidents: Bounded redacted structured errors/traces/counts; runtime error candidates limited to 3/day and 10-minute cooldown; no automatic installation
self_development.validation_limits: Python/JS syntax and three fixed speech regressions; not universal feature correctness or a complete security certification
self_development.permission_incidents: Displayed as blocked_by_policy; no repair button, and development.propose refuses to treat permission denials as bugs

startup.codex: Native Hermes prompt/history lifecycle plus Codex app-server initialize, thread start/resume and account/read before ready; no synthetic conversation or startup model turn
